task_message:
Case M26: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 261x261x510 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M26 finished.

**Summary:**
- **Lesion found:** A well-circumscribed, strongly T2-hyperintense (myxoid) soft-tissue mass in the (right) thigh, located at the lateral/anterior aspect of the limb, extending obliquely over ~12 cm (axial slices 267–387), ~60 mm AP (coronal 106–166) and ~43 mm transverse (sagittal 162–205).
- **Segmentation:** Seeded with two interior points on sagittal 180 (marks 918, 870); the model produced a single connected mask (121.2 mL) whose green outline follows the bright core plus its slightly less intense periphery in all three planes.
- **Verification:** Checked mask ends (axial 272, 285, 375, 382) and zoomed sagittal/coronal views — boundary matches the lesion edge; slices 8 mm past each end are clean. Automatic candidates C1/C2 (subcutaneous fat crescents), C3 (dark peritumoral ring) and C4 (skin spot) were rejected as non-lesion tissue.
- **Result saved:** v1, 121.2 mL, 1 component, confidence high (19/40 tool calls, 1/15 prompts used).
